newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 8.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan may allow students to apply for universities next year, with each department allowing to accept up to three students without taking joint university entrance examination
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co allots T$1.5 billion worth of shares to employees as bonus
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to allow Chinese vessels to ship cargo from Kaohsiung to other international ports
United States may appoint Central Intelligence Agency official Richard Bush as chairman of American Institute in Taiwan
LIBERTY TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says new cabinet should be economy- and finance-oriented
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Labour Council to discuss how Labour Standards Law can best apply to employees
-- State-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp to reduce oil prices by two percent starting Saturday
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government to revise law requiring listed firms to reveal investment projects in China in order to protect shareholders' interest.
